heading: Our only emergency room is at risk
text: St. Mary's is the only A&E within 40 minutes of our town. The hospital board votes next month on closing it. Local businesses will match every gift made before Friday, up to £25,000.
donate_text: Every pound you give before Friday is matched by local businesses, up to £25,000.

reasons.title: Ads that reach voters
reasons.text: Digital and radio ads in the districts that decide this fight.

reasons.title: Organizers on the ground
reasons.text: Paid organizers who knock doors and recruit volunteers.

reasons.title: Legal defence
reasons.text: Lawyers ready to challenge the decision in court.
